name: Shreyansh Tripathy
headline: Physics graduate with an interest in applied physics and efficient systems
bio: I’m Shreyansh Tripathy, a Physics graduate with a B.Sc. (Honours) from Azim Premji University, Bangalore. My interest lies in applied physics, especially building and understanding efficient systems through experimentation, simulation, and careful analysis. Beyond academics, I enjoy basketball, reading comics, and continuing to learn coding.
